10.129.244.207.summary: Target or perimeter firewall employs TCP Tarpits (`xt_TARPIT` or LaBrea style mute listeners).
indicators: 1 port(s) completed TCP handshakes but held connections mute without emitting application banners (tarpit behavior)
10.129.244.207.recommended_action: Filter out silent ports by showing only verified open services (`--show open`).
